AWI-ESM 1 REcoM (2024): 
aerosol: none
atmos: ECHAM6.3.04p1 (T63L47 native atmosphere T63 gaussian grid; 192 x 96 longitude/latitude; 47 levels; top level 80 km)
atmosChem: none
land: JSBACH 3.20 with dynamic vegetation
landIce: none
ocean: FESOM 1.4 (unstructured grid in the horizontal with 126859 wet nodes; 46 levels; top grid cell 0-5 m)
ocnBgchem: REcoM2 (same grid as ocean component)
seaIce: FESOM 1.4 (same grid as ocean component)
